title: A review of Chinese contracts, disclosures, and other documents identifies $3.2B+ in compute projects built or planned around Nvidia GPUs restricted by the US (Eduardo Baptista/Reuters)
summary: Eduardo Baptista / Reuters: A review of Chinese contracts, disclosures, and other documents identifies $3.2B+ in compute projects built or planned around Nvidia GPUs restricted by the US — Nvidia has said US export controls have effectively shut it out of China's AI data-centre market, but a Reuters review has identified …
